name: DSNet anchor-free TVSum split 0
checkpoint_choice: TVSum split 0 fixed before Video2Reaction evaluation; no checkpoint or split sweep
preprocessing: Published DSNet video_helper: RGB, resize shorter side to 256, center crop 224, ImageNet normalization, sequential GoogLeNet pool5, L2 normalize with norm+1e-10; float32
score: Published DSNetAF.predict per-position sigmoid classification times sigmoid centerness, divided by clip maximum + 1e-8
adaptation: Apply to the supplied chronological scene keyframes. Use per-position confidence for Top-K, retain predicted boxes as diagnostics. This is a keyframe transfer of a video summarization model, not its original dense-video knapsack summary protocol.
supervision: Frozen external TVSum model; scores are pseudo-labels, never Video2Reaction highlight ground truth
